notes.title: The Godfeather 1.5 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to version 1.5 of The Godfeather![/b]

This version of the game is now fully localised in the following langauges:
[list]
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazil Portuguese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[/list]

New quality of life features:
[list]
[*] Crosshairs for easier poop assassination
[*] Highlighting of onscreen targets
[*] Loads of bug fixes
[/list]

Now is the best time to begin your journey up the ranks of the pigeon underworld and discover the terrible secret at the heart of the bird mafia.

Don't forget to leave us a lovely review if you enjoy your time with The Godfeather!
